nl: Leftover processes from an earlier sync are still running: their command lines contain sync-job-4. Stop all of them. The process whose command line contains keep-alive-4 must keep running.

setup.description: 3 processes with sync-job-4 and one with keep-alive-4 run tools/idle.py.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/idle.py sync-job-4-a > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py sync-job-4-b > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py sync-job-4-c > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
setsid python3 tools/idle.py keep-alive-4 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 0.5
setup.pwsh:
$py = if ($IsWindows) { 'python' } else { 'python3' }
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','sync-job-4-a'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','sync-job-4-b'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','sync-job-4-c'
Start-Process $py -ArgumentList 'tools/idle.py','keep-alive-4'
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1

teardown.bash: pkill -f -- sync-job-4 || true; pkill -f -- keep-alive-4 || true
teardown.pwsh:
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*sync-job-4*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*keep-alive-4*' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

negatives.defect: also stops the process that must keep running
